title: Dev Deepawali Kashi Package
bestFor: Families, Couples, Groups & First-Time Visitors to Kashi
overview: Once a year Varanasi does something no other city can: every ghat along the river is lit with lakhs of diyas, and for one night the whole riverfront glows. That is Dev Deepawali, and pictures genuinely do not do it justice. It falls on 24 November 2026, and Safar Trails has put together a 3 days / 2 nights package from ₹11,999 per person so you are not booking hotels, cabs and boats separately in the busiest week of the year. Two nights in a hotel close to the ghats, a private cab for your pickup, drop and sightseeing, Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, and a boat on the river on Dev Deepawali night itself — which is the part everyone books the trip for.
highlights: Dev Deepawali night — the ghats lit end to end with lakhs of diyas
Boat on the Ganga on Dev Deepawali night, booked in advance rather than haggled for on the day
Sarnath — where the Buddha gave his first sermon, half an hour out of the city
A morning boat ride while the ghats are still quiet, which is when the photographs happen
inclusions: 2 nights' hotel stay close to the ghats, with daily breakfast
Private cab for pickup, drop and local sightseeing
Boat ride on the Ganga on Dev Deepawali night
Safar Trails support team available throughout your trip
exclusions: Airfare or train fare to and from Varanasi
Monument and temple entry fees, where applicable

itinerary.title: You Land, We Take Over
itinerary.description: Straight from the airport or station to your hotel — no confusion, no haggling with local drivers. Check in, rest a while, and in the evening walk down to Dashashwamedh Ghat for the regular Ganga Aarti. It is a good warm-up for what is coming the next night.
itinerary.morningActivity: Airport or railway station pickup and hotel check-in

itinerary.title: The Big Night — Dev Deepawali
itinerary.description: The morning starts slow with a boat ride while the ghats are still quiet, which is honestly the best time for photographs. Then Kashi Vishwanath darshan, and a short trip out to Sarnath. Come evening it is showtime: the ghats lit end to end, your boat waiting, and the Ganga Aarti happening right in front of you. This is the part everyone books the trip for.
itinerary.morningActivity: Early boat ride on a quiet river
itinerary.eveningActivity: Dev Deepawali — the lit ghats from your boat, and the Ganga Aarti

itinerary.title: Heading Back
itinerary.description: Breakfast, then some last-minute shopping if you want it — Banarasi sarees and brass idols both travel well as gifts. Drop at the airport or railway station after that. You leave with a phone full of photos and the kind of memories that stick.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Optional shopping, then the airport or station drop

seoTitle: Dev Deepawali Kashi Package 2026 ★ 3D/2N ₹11,999 | Safar Trails
seoDescription: Witness Dev Deepawali in Varanasi with Safar Trails — 3 Days 2 Nights from ₹11,999, including hotel, private cab and a Ganga boat ride on the big night.

faqs.question: When is Dev Deepawali 2026?
faqs.answer: 24 November 2026. It falls on Kartik Purnima, fifteen days after Diwali, and it is one night only — the trip is built around being in Varanasi on that evening.

faqs.question: What does ₹11,999 per person cover?
faqs.answer: Two nights' hotel stay near the ghats with daily breakfast, a private cab for your pickup, drop and local sightseeing, the Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, and a boat on the river on Dev Deepawali night. Flights and trains to Varanasi, lunch and dinner, temple entry fees and personal spending are not included.

faqs.question: Is the boat on Dev Deepawali night really included?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is the reason to book early. On that one night boats are the scarcest thing in the city and the rates asked at the ghat go through the roof. Yours is arranged in advance as part of the package.

faqs.question: How early should I book?
faqs.answer: As early as you can. Hotels near the ghats and boats for Dev Deepawali night both sell out well before the date, and what is left in the last week is expensive and far from the river. Booking early is what keeps this trip at ₹11,999.

faqs.question: Is travel to Varanasi included?
faqs.answer: No — flights and train tickets to and from Varanasi are yours to book. Everything from the airport or station onwards is ours. If you would like us to quote the tickets as well, tell us where you are starting from.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be changed?
faqs.answer: Yes. The hotel category, the number of nights and the sightseeing can all be adjusted — the one fixed point is being on the river on Dev Deepawali night. Tell us what you would rather do and we will quote it before you pay anything.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for elderly parents?
faqs.answer: Largely yes, with one caution: Dev Deepawali night brings very large crowds to the ghats, and the lanes around Kashi Vishwanath are narrow and busy. The boat means you watch the lit ghats from the water rather than from inside the crowd, which is the easier way to see it. Tell us if anyone in the group has trouble with steps and we will plan around it.
